note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a wooded hillside above 30-acre Butler Lake near Carrollton, its long spur loops climbing away from the lake. Some sites are narrow, and traffic on the highway below can be heard. Winter reservations are taken by phone. Lodge, pool, restaurant and lake boat rentals in the park. --Claude
